examples.question: Which customers have placed more than 10 orders? Return only their names.
examples.sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 10
examples.reference: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

examples.question: How many units of the product named 'Red Racket' have been ordered in total, across all orders? Return 0 if none (or if no such product exists).
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE name='Red Racket' LIMIT 1)
examples.reference: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Red Racket'

examples.question: How many units of the product named 'Red Racket' have been ordered in total, across all orders? Return 0 if none (or if no such product exists).
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id= p.id WHERE p.name='Red Racket' AND p.category='tool'
examples.reference: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Red Racket'

examples.question: How many units of the product named 'Mega Ball' have been ordered in total, across all orders? Return 0 if none (or if no such product exists).
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id=186 AND (oi.unit_price<0 OR oi.quantity>0)
examples.reference: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Mega Ball'

examples.question: How many units of the product named 'Mega Ball' have been ordered in total, across all orders? Return 0 if none (or if no such product exists).
examples.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity),0) as total_units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.name='Mega Ball' JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id
examples.reference: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Mega Ball'

examples.question: What is the name of the most expensive product in the Books category?
examples.sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id=OI.order_id WHERE p.category LIKE '%Books%' ORDER BY p.price DESC LIMIT 1
examples.reference: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Books' ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

examples.question: Which products were never ordered in 2025? Return only the product names.
examples.sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items ooi)
examples.reference: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT oi.product_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31')

examples.question: Which customers have placed more than 12 orders? Return only their names.

examples.reference: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 12

examples.question: Which products have never been ordered by customers from UK? Return only the product names .
examples.sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items)
examples.reference: SELECT name FROM products WHERE name NOT IN (SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE c.country = 'UK')

examples.question: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount spent (sum of quantity * unit_price) on orders that were not cancelled? Return only their names.
examples.sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status!='cancelled' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 5
examples.reference: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 5

examples.question: Which product categories have more than 2 products priced below 30? Return the category and the number of such products.
examples.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price<30 GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*)>2 LIMIT 1
examples.reference: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price < 30 GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
